module.name: F5 CNE Port List
module.description: Creates F5BigCnePortlist custom resource for managing port lists used in firewall policies and access control rules.

required.reason: FLO provides F5BigCnePortlist CRD and controller

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Name of the Kubernetes cluster (used for resource identification)

required.name: list_name
required.description: Name for the port list resource

required.name: flo_ready
required.description: Dependency flag ensuring FLO is ready

required.name: ports
required.description: List of ports or port ranges (e.g., '80', '443', '8000-8999')

key_outputs.name: list_ready
key_outputs.description: Flag indicating port list is ready

key_outputs.name: list_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the created port list

key_outputs.name: list_namespace
key_outputs.description: Namespace where port list is deployed
